en.headline: HKEX studies merging GEM with Main Board under new chapter
en.dek: A source told the South China Morning Post the exchange is examining a Chapter 18D listing rule that would absorb more than 300 GEM companies, with public consultation possible by year-end.
body: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing is studying whether to merge its GEM board with the Main Board by adding a new chapter to the listing rules, a person familiar with the discussions told the South China Morning Post on Thursday.

The proposal under review would create Chapter 18D as part of the second phase of a listing-regime review, allowing the more than 300 companies now listed on GEM to sit under a dedicated Main Board chapter. The source said a public consultation could follow by the end of the year. GEM has long been intended as a market for smaller and emerging firms, but turnover and new listings have been thin.

According to figures cited in local reports of exchange data, GEM had more than 300 stocks as of July, with a combined market capitalisation of more than HK$65 billion. Separate reporting of mid-year figures put the number of GEM issuers at 305 in June, with only one new GEM listing in the first half of 2026 against 86 on the Main Board.

In a statement responding to the report, the exchange said it had implemented first-phase measures to strengthen the listing regime and that those steps had received broad market support. It said it would continue to study further enhancements so the framework stays current and meets market needs, and would announce progress in due course. The exchange did not confirm a merger timetable.

zh.headline: 港交所據報研究GEM併入主板 擬增設18D章
zh.dek: 南華早報引述消息人士指，交易所正研究在《上市規則》新增第18D章，把逾300家GEM公司納入主板專章，或於年底諮詢公眾。
body: 南華早報周四引述熟悉討論的消息人士報道，香港交易所正研究把GEM板與主板合併，透過在《上市規則》增設新章節吸納現時逾300家GEM上市公司。
報道指，有關構思屬上市制度第二階段檢討的核心內容之一，擬新增第18D章，讓規模較小的企業在主板一個專門章節上市，並可能於今年年底前進行公眾諮詢。GEM早年為中小型及新興企業而設，但近年交投及新股數量偏少。
本地報道引述交易所數據稱，截至今年7月，GEM有逾300隻股份，總市值逾654億元。另有報道指截至6月GEM發行人約305家，2026年上半年僅有1家新上市，同期主板新上市公司達86家。
港交所回覆查詢時表示，已落實第一階段提升上市機制競爭力的措施，並獲市場廣泛支持。交易所將繼續研究更多提升上市機制的措施，確保與時並進、切合市場發展需要，並會適時公布相關進展。港交所並未確認合併時間表。
